description: This file contains test cases for the OpenClawKit UI actions, specifically testing methods for sanitizing tag values, extracting action names from dictionaries, and formatting agent messages. It uses a testing framework and references the OpenClawKit module.

classes.name: CanvasA2UIActionTests
classes.description: A test suite containing unit tests for the OpenClawCanvasA2UIAction related functionalities.

methods.name: sanitizeTagValueIsStable
methods.description: Test to ensure the sanitizeTagValue method produces consistent and predictable output for various input strings.

methods.name: extractActionNameAcceptsNameOrAction
methods.description: Test to verify extractActionName correctly retrieves the action name from different dictionary inputs.

methods.name: formatAgentMessageIsTokenEfficientAndUnambiguous
methods.description: Test to verify that the formatAgentMessage method correctly formats agent messages with expected substrings.
